limits: The test covers four selected blocks only. No full-epoch migration or serving-coverage claim.
Object counts and KV counts come from actual response receipts. Streamed expected byte counts are separate from buffered completed-byte headers.
R2 GETs are API operations, not physical disk-read measurements. Physical R2 and provider caches are uncontrolled.
Only count-matched unsampled phases support a matched observed component estimate. Incomplete or sampled HIT groups are labelled separately.
Invocation CPU and attributed startup CPU are separate. Startup is an observed attribution in this small run, not a predicted startup rate at scale.
The one-percent log allowance shown is an expectation of one invocation event per sampled request, not measured log usage. Current Analytics Engine billing is zero.
Published marginal rates exclude shared account allowances, monthly billing rounding, minimum subscription, fixed storage and future pricing changes.
Small sample confidence intervals are marked invalid by the platform. No statistical confidence claim is made.
